quarterly_data.signal: Silicon Motion 20-F customer concentration: sales to its five largest customers were approximately 66% of 2025 net revenue (66% in 2024, 61% in 2023) and its top ten customers approximately 82%. Four customers each above 10% made up 58% of 2025 net sales: PHISEMI US$216,456 thousand (24%), Kioxia (12%), AFASTOR US$104,248 thousand (12%) and Micron (10%); in 2023 SK Hynix was also a 10%-or-more customer (12%). Most of its high-performance flash memory storage controllers are supplied to NAND flash manufacturers; customers also include module makers, hyperscalers and OEMs.
quarterly_data.figure: top five 66%; PHISEMI 24%, Kioxia 12%, AFASTOR 12%, Micron 10% (2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Silicon Motion 20-F supplier disclosure: two outside foundries - primarily TSMC and secondarily SMIC - fabricate its semiconductors in Taiwan and China, primarily on process nodes from 6 to 55 nanometers. Its primary assembly and test subcontractors are SPIL, Powertech Technology (PTI), ASE, Orient Semiconductor Electronics (OSE), Huatian Technology, Tongfu Microelectronics, King Yuan Electronics (KYEC) and YoungTek Electronics. It has no long-term agreements with these foundries and subcontractors and orders against customers' purchase orders and forecasts; it cites packaging component shortages including T-Glass substrate as a risk at its foundries and subcontractors. Order-to-shipment takes approximately three months and up to six months when independent foundry capacity is fully utilized.

Silicon Motion 20-F 2025 product mix: net sales rose 10% to US$885.6 million on new products, new customer ramps and share gains with NAND makers, module makers and OEMs. SSD controller sales decreased in the range of 0% to 5% to 45% to 50% of revenue; eMMC plus UFS controller sales increased 20% to 25% to 40% to 45% of revenue; SSD solutions sales decreased 10% to 15% to 0% to 5% of revenue. Gross margin rose to 48.3% from 45.9%; 2025 capital expenditures were US$55,065 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: SSD controllers 45%-50% of revenue; eMMC+UFS 40%-45%; SSD solutions 0%-5%; gross margin 48.3%

contracts.signal: Silicon Motion 20-F: Kioxia was a 10%-or-more customer, accounting for 12% of net revenue in 2025 (US$105,704 thousand) and 15% in 2024 (US$119,727 thousand).
Silicon Motion 20-F: Micron was a 10%-or-more customer, accounting for 10% of net revenue in 2025 (US$86,201 thousand), 19% in 2024 (US$151,780 thousand) and 22% in 2023 (US$144,011 thousand).
